story.title: Our Love Story
story.subtitle: From serendipitous beginnings to a lifetime of love and discovery
paragraphs: It all started on a crisp autumn evening at a quiet cafe overlooking the harbour. What began as an hour-long coffee conversation effortlessly stretched into midnight walks under amber street lamps, filled with shared laughter, dreams of foreign travels, and an unmistakable sense that we had found home in one another.
Over four beautiful years of journeys—from road trips along cliffside coastlines to celebrating life's quiet milestones together—every memory has brought us closer.
Now, with immense joy and gratitude, we invite you to join us where the azure sea meets the sky to witness and celebrate our sacred vows.
story.quote: “Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.” — Emily Brontë
